enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Close eyes. Pull the blanket over the body. Turn to the side. Remain still. Breathe steadily. Shift arm under the pillow. Turn to the other side. Remain lying down. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Continue lying on the bed.

Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing legs to the floor. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Open the door. Step in. Reach for the light switch. Turn on the light. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Cup hands under the water. Rinse face. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into the sink. Put down the toothbrush. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Hang the towel back. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk carton. Take out the bread. Close the refrigerator door. Put the bread on the counter. Open the cabinet. Take out a plate. Put the plate on the counter. Pick up a knife. Cut the bread. Put the slices on the plate. Pick up the kettle. Fill it with water at the sink. Put the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch. Open the refrigerator. Take out the butter. Close the refrigerator. Spread butter on the bread with the knife. Put the knife down. Pick up the plate. Walk to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up a slice of bread. Eat the bread. Pick up the cup. Pour milk into the cup. Drink the milk. Stand up. Carry the plate and cup to the sink. Rinse the plate and cup. Put them on the drying rack. Wipe the table with a cloth. Turn off the light. Walk out of the kitchen.

Walk to the front door. Pick up the bag. Pick up the keys. Open the door. Step out. Close the door. Lock the door with the key. Put the keys in the pocket. Walk down the path. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the stop. Take out the phone. Look at the phone screen. Put the phone back in the pocket. Step onto the bus. Take out the transit card. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on a seat. Hold the bag on the lap. Stand up when the stop arrives. Walk to the bus door. Step off the bus. Walk to the workplace entrance. Open the door. Step inside. Walk to the locker room. Open the locker. Take out the work uniform. Change into the uniform. Close the locker.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the nurse station. Pick up the clipboard. Read the patient list. Walk to patient room 1. Open the door. Greet the patient. Say 'Good morning, how are you feeling today?' Check the IV drip. Adjust the drip rate. Pick up the thermometer. Place it under the patient's tongue. Wait. Take out the thermometer. Read the temperature. Write the reading on the chart. Put down the thermometer. Walk to the medication cart. Pick up the pill cup. Pick up the water cup. Carry them to the patient. Hand the pill cup to the patient. Hand the water cup to the patient. Take back the empty cups. Walk to the next patient room. Open the door. Check the blood pressure cuff. Wrap the cuff around the patient's arm. Press the start button on the monitor. Read the screen. Write the reading on the chart. Remove the cuff. Walk back to the nurse station. Sit at the desk. Pick up the phone. Dial the doctor's extension. Say 'Patient in room 3 needs a review.' Put down the phone. Pick up the pen. Write notes in the log. Stand up. Walk to the supply closet. Open the door. Take out gauze and gloves. Close the door. Carry the supplies to the cart. Place them on the cart. Walk to patient room 3. Open the door. Put on gloves. Change the wound dressing. Remove the old gauze. Place new gauze. Press tape over the gauze. Remove the gloves. Throw the gloves in the bin. Say 'All done, press the call button if you need anything.' Walk out of the room. Return to the nurse station. Sit down. Pick up the pen. Update the patient record. Walk to the break room. Sit on the chair. Open the lunch bag. Eat the sandwich. Drink water. Stand up. Throw the wrapper in the bin. Walk back to the nurse station. Pick up the clipboard. Do the afternoon rounds. Check each patient's monitor. Note the readings. Sit at the desk. Type notes on the computer. Press the keyboard keys. Save the file. Stand up. Walk to the locker room. Open the locker. Change out of the uniform. Put on the coat. Close the locker. Walk to the exit. Open the door. Step outside.

Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the stop. Take out the phone. Check messages on the phone. Put the phone in the pocket. Step onto the bus. Take out the transit card. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on a seat. Put the bag on the lap. Look out the window. Stand up at the stop. Walk to the bus door. Step off the bus. Walk along the street. Walk to the front door. Take out the keys. Insert the key in the lock. Turn the key. Open the door. Step inside. Close the door. Lock the door. Put the keys on the hook. Take off the shoes. Place the shoes on the rack. Take off the coat. Hang the coat on the hook.

Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the light. Open the refrigerator. Take out the vegetables. Take out the chicken. Close the refrigerator. Put the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables. Put the pieces in a bowl. Pick up the chicken. Place it on the cutting board. Cut the chicken. Put the pieces in another bowl. Turn on the range hood. Turn on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Wait for the oil to heat. Put the chicken in the pan. Stir with a spatula. Add the vegetables. Stir again. Add salt. Stir. Turn off the induction cooker. Turn off the range hood. Pick up a plate. Scoop the food onto the plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit on the chair. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the food. Drink water. Stand up. Carry the plate and bowl to the sink. Rinse them. Put them in the dishwasher. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Turn off the light. Walk out of the kitchen.

Walk into the living room. Turn on the light. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button on the TV. Sit on the sofa. Lean back. Press the channel button. Watch the screen. Pick up the phone. Scroll on the phone. Put the phone down on the sofa. Pick up the water bottle from the table. Drink water. Put the bottle down. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen. Open the refrigerator. Take out a snack. Close the refrigerator. Walk back to the living room. Sit on the sofa. Open the snack bag. Eat the snack. Press the volume button on the remote. Put the remote on the table. Pick up the laptop from the table. Open the laptop. Press the power button. Type on the keyboard. Close the laptop. Put the laptop on the table. Lean back on the sofa. Watch the TV. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Open the door. Step in. Use the toilet. Turn on the tap. Wash hands. Turn off the tap. Open the door. Walk back to the living room. Sit on the sofa. Watch the TV. Press the power button on the remote. Turn off the TV. Stand up. Turn off the light. Walk out of the living room.

Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the light. Open the shower curtain. Turn on the water heater switch. Turn on the shower tap. Adjust the water temperature. Step under the water. Wet the hair. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the hand. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap on the body. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair. Dry the body. Wrap the towel around the body. Step out of the shower. Wipe the floor with a mop. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into the sink. Put down the toothbrush. Hang the towel on the rack. Turn off the light. Open the door. Walk out of the bathroom.

Walk into the bedroom. Turn on the desk lamp. Take off the clothes. Put on the pajamas. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Look at the screen. Put the phone back on the nightstand. Reach to the desk lamp. Turn off the desk lamp. Close eyes. Turn to the side. Adjust the pillow. Remain lying down. Breathe steadily. Remain still.
